# Fedora Linux issue triage with dnf, systemd and SELinux

Curated by Skill Harbor — from the github/awesome-copilot collection: a Fedora Linux expert prompt-skill that turns the agent into a distro-aware troubleshooter. The workflow confirms the Fedora release and environment assumptions, produces a step-by-step triage plan using systemctl, journalctl and dnf, offers copy-paste-ready remediation commands with verification after each major change, addresses SELinux and firewalld considerations where relevant, and closes with rollback or cleanup steps — all returned in a fixed Summary / Triage Steps / Remediation Commands / Validation / Rollback structure with optional release, problem-summary and constraint inputs. Honest caveat: this is a guidance template, not a diagnostic tool — it will not detect your Fedora release or issue by itself, and remediation commands should be reviewed before running on production systems. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
